critical_failures: Consignee mismatch: certificate states CENTURY GATE CO. LTD in Saudi Arabia, invoice states Paper Vantage Point Pvt Ltd in India.
Goods description mismatch: certificate states Tissue Paper - (Napkin & Facial), invoice states Kraft Liner Board.
Quantity mismatch: certificate states 88452 kg GW/NW and 434 reels, invoice states Total MT 53.8900 and 18 reels.
Origin mismatch: certificate states India, invoice states Country of Origin Sweden.
overall_assessment.decision_summary: Documents are not identical. The consignor matches, but consignee, goods description, quantity and country of origin do not match the invoice.
overall_assessment.human_explanation: Certifikatet anger mottagaren som CENTURY GATE CO. LTD i Saudiarabien, medan fakturan är ställd till Paper Vantage Point Pvt Ltd i Indien. Certifikatet avser Tissue Paper med ursprung Indien och 88452 kg, medan fakturan avser Kraft Liner Board med ursprung Sverige och total 53.8900 MT. Dokumenten kan därför inte godkännas automatiskt.
